A VESC BMS can only be read through a VESC controller on the same link.
Only VESC can carry several sources over one link, so the extra ones will stay offline.

These two batteries report the same cell count and the same voltage. Are they one pack reached two ways? If so, mark them as one below — otherwise the vehicle counts twice the battery it has. If they are two separate packs, leave them alone: marking them would show HALF the capacity you really have. Only you can tell them apart.

Does this head unit drive a motor itself? It has never reported one, while the devices on its CAN bus have. If it is only a display, remove this controller — otherwise it either drags the vehicle voltage down or wastes a poll every cycle.
